purpose: Hot state for recurring XerahS hourly review selection. Keep this file small and machine-readable; archive raw detail separately.
selection_rules: Read this JSON first, then the short current tracker only if human context is needed.
Prefer the stalest high-priority area that is not blocked by a larger prerequisite.
After a run, update the matching area, prepend one compact last_runs item, and archive detailed evidence by log path only.
Do not paste full build/test output into hot state or the current tracker.
